# Praxist Code of Conduct

## Our Standard

Praxist contributors and maintainers are expected to communicate
professionally, review ideas on their technical merits, disclose relevant
conflicts of interest, and make room for differing experience and viewpoints.
Constructive disagreement is welcome; personal attacks are not.

Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, deliberate
disruption, publication of another person's private information, or repeated
unwelcome conduct.

## Scope

This standard applies in the repository, issue tracker, pull requests, project
discussions, release channels, and other spaces where a person represents the
Praxist project.

## Reporting and Enforcement

Report conduct concerns privately to `praxist@sapient.inc` with the subject
`Code of Conduct`. Do not open a public issue containing private or sensitive
details. Maintainers will limit disclosure to the people needed to review the
report and may remove content, restrict participation, reject contributions, or
take other proportionate action.

Maintainers who are directly involved in a report must not decide its outcome.
Good-faith reports and participation in an investigation must not result in
retaliation.
